name: organization_entitlements.organization_entitlements_plan_state_check
definition: CHECK ((((source_grant_id IS NULL) AND (((billing_scope_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_subscription_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_subscription_revision IS NOT NULL) AND (state = ANY (ARRAY['trialing'::text, 'active'::text, 'grace'::text, 'past_due'::text, 'unpaid'::text, 'paused'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'incomplete'::text, 'incomplete_expired'::text])) AND (access = ANY (ARRAY['granted'::text, 'read_only'::text, 'denied'::text])) AND (entitlement_effective = (access = 'granted'::text))) OR ((billing_scope_id IS NULL) AND (plan_key = ANY (ARRAY['free'::text, 'plus_monthly'::text, 'pro_monthly'::text])) AND (state = ANY (ARRAY['free'::text, 'active'::text, 'grace'::text, 'past_due'::text, 'unpaid'::text])) AND (((plan_key = 'free'::text) AND (state = 'free'::text) AND entitlement_effective AND ((source_subscription_id IS NULL) = (source_subscription_revision IS NULL))) OR ((plan_key <> 'free'::text) AND (state <> 'free'::text) AND (source_subscription_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_subscription_revision IS NOT NULL) AND (entitlement_effective = (state = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'grace'::text])))))))) OR ((source_grant_id IS NOT NULL) AND (billing_scope_id IS NULL) AND (plan_key = ANY (ARRAY['plus_monthly'::text, 'pro_monthly'::text])) AND (state = 'active'::text) AND entitlement_effective AND (access = 'granted'::text) AND (source_subscription_id IS NULL) AND (source_subscription_revision IS NULL) AND (effective_until IS NOT NULL)))) validated:true

name: subscription_allowance_periods.subscription_allowance_periods_invoice_id_check
definition: CHECK ((((provider = 'stripe'::text) AND (provider_environment = ANY (ARRAY['test'::text, 'live'::text])) AND (subscription_id IS NOT NULL) AND (subscription_revision IS NOT NULL) AND (promo_grant_id IS NULL) AND (((grant_source = 'paid_invoice'::text) AND (stripe_invoice_id IS NOT NULL) AND (stripe_invoice_id ~ '^in_[A-Za-z0-9]+$'::text) AND (trial_claim_id IS NULL)) OR ((grant_source = 'trial_claim'::text) AND (billing_scope_id IS NOT NULL) AND (stripe_invoice_id IS NULL) AND (trial_claim_id IS NOT NULL)))) OR ((grant_source = 'promo_grant'::text) AND (provider = 'eliza'::text) AND (provider_environment = ANY (ARRAY['test'::text, 'live'::text])) AND (billing_scope_id IS NULL) AND (merchant_key = 'platform'::text) AND (subscription_id IS NULL) AND (subscription_revision IS NULL) AND (stripe_invoice_id IS NULL) AND (trial_claim_id IS NULL) AND (promo_grant_id IS NOT NULL)))) validated:true
